## `get_defaults`

*Available in [R](#get_defaults-r)*
=== "R"
    <h4>Description</h4>

    This function returns the user level defaults set in ~/cida_defaults.dcf

    <h4>Usage</h4>
    ```R

    get_defaults()

    ```
    <h4>Arguments</h4>
    *No arguments*
    <h4>Returns</h4>

    The user level defaults
